mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies at 63 degrees near Verona Area High School. The moon is in a waxing crescent phase, and the ISS will be visible tonight starting at 8:23 PM for 6 minutes, traveling from the West Northwest over Cross Plains toward the Northeast near Madison, reaching halfway up the sky. Tonight's low will be 60 degrees, and please prepare for rain overnight.

The Verona Police Department released a summary of notable calls from August 31 through September 14, which included a variety of traffic stops, a burglary incident, and an investigation into a school staff member.

Today, you can participate in Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, we have a packed schedule with trivia nights at Hop Haus Brewing Company, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music and the Farmer's Market downtown.
On September 3, a 33-year-old Madison man was arrested for O W I second offence after crashing his vehicle on Shooting Star Road.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed today for a remodel, so the store will not be serving its flavor of the day.
